questions.stem: What is the main feature of a positional number system?
choices: It uses symbols for all landmark numbers
It determines the value of a symbol based on its position
It uses a seashell as a placeholder
questions.solution: The main feature of a positional number system is that it determines the value of a symbol based on its position. This is because the same symbol can represent different values depending on where it is placed in the number. The other options are incorrect because not all positional systems use base-10, they do not necessarily use symbols for all landmark numbers, and while placeholders like a seashell might be used, they are not the defining characteristic.
